messages:
alex: Quick thread: finalizing billing dashboard layout options. Two proposals: A) compact top row with Org + Project tiles (side-by-side), B) single large summary + swipeable project carousel. Which is better for discoverability?
meera: I prefer the compact top row (A). Projects need to be discoverable for teams with dozens of projects. Carousel feels like "hidden" content.
jordan: Carousel can work if we surface the top 3 projects as mini-tile previews and have a clear "See all" action. But agree it adds interaction cost.
sam: If we go with A, we should add a persistent project-picker in the header too (typeahead). That way power users can jump fast.
eva: Accessibility: carousels are notoriously hard for keyboard/sr. If we choose carousel we must provide non-swipe controls and proper aria-roledescription.
alex: Good call on aria. Also decision point: where to put invoice actions? Inline under org summary (download, view, dispute) or a separate invoices panel?
jordan: Inline is faster for support workflows. Make them compact links with icon + text; add hover previews of invoice amount and date.
meera: Copy nit: use "Download invoice" not just "Download" so screen readers have context.
sam: UX nit: add hover state that expands invoice row to show line items (or a quick preview modal) to avoid extra navigation.
eva: Accessibility nit: color contrast for token legend still low for orange/peach pair. Suggest adding dashed patterns and textual labels next to each legend item.
jordan: Token chart: can we surface per-token-type totals as microcards below the chart? Users often want quick numbers, not just a graphic.
alex: I like microcards. They can include small sparklines + total tokens + cost. Also we need a CSV export CTA visible on the main view (not buried).
design-bot: Mock uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh5678/Billing-dashboard-swipe-vs-tiles Includes: A and B variants, keyboard order annotations, invoice inline row example, microcards, and color + pattern legend.
meera: Pattern legend + text labels look great. Two small asks: 1) show billed currency badge near totals, 2) make the invoice ID copy button 16px and keyboard reachable.
sam: For mobile, variant A should collapse to stacked tiles with an accordion for invoices. No horizontal carousels on small screens.
eva: Add aria-live region for the main total when time range toggles. Also ensure CSV download triggers an accessible notification ("Export ready: billing-2026-xx.csv") via toast with role=alert.
jordan: Data question: which default timeframe? rolling 30d or current calendar month? Product analytics suggests rolling 30d; finance wants calendar month.
alex: We'll A/B test default timeframe per new users for 2 weeks and log metric: <invoice clicks per user>, <csv exports>, <help ticket rate about invoices>.
meera: I'll draft experiment plan and include success criteria. Ticket: #PRD-1902.
design-bot: ETA: I'll post finalized mocks + accessibility spec by Wed EOD. Also included HTML snippet for the pattern legend and aria attributes.
alex: Thanks. Quick action items: design to add copy tweaks + invoice inline row, eng to estimate keyboard focus states, support to compile top 5 invoice-related support threads. Review Thurs 30m. :calendar:
